profile.description: Common GitHub work-surface and GitHub Actions terminology that is not owned by the generic Git or software-core profiles.

terms.definition: A GitHub user assigned responsibility for an issue or pull request.
The branch that receives changes when a GitHub pull request is merged.
A GitHub-designated owner whose review can be requested for matching repository paths.
A person granted access to collaborate on a GitHub repository.
The branch containing proposed changes in a GitHub pull request.
The repository branch GitHub uses by default for new pull requests and related operations.
A GitHub pull request explicitly marked as not ready for final review.
A repository copy associated with another GitHub repository, or the operation that creates it.
A GitHub work item used to track a task, question, defect, or proposed improvement.
A GitHub classification attached to an issue or pull request, or the act of attaching it.
A GitHub grouping used to track progress for a set of issues or pull requests.
A GitHub branch with configured restrictions on changes or integration.
A GitHub proposal to review and integrate changes from one branch into another.
A GitHub review that comments on, approves, or requests changes to a pull request.
The GitHub user or organization that owns a repository.
A comment made as part of review activity on a GitHub pull request.
A GitHub-reported result used to indicate whether a commit or pull request satisfies a configured check.
The GitHub automation system that runs configured workflows in response to events or manual invocation.
A reusable GitHub Actions task that can be included in a workflow step.
provenance: GitHub Actions workflows and actions documentation; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: A GitHub Action that combines multiple workflow steps into one reusable action.
provenance: GitHub Actions workflows and actions documentation; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: A configurable automated process defined for a GitHub repository and composed of one or more jobs.
provenance: GitHub Actions workflows and actions documentation; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: A GitHub Actions workflow that another workflow can call.
provenance: GitHub Actions reusable workflows documentation; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: A YAML file in a GitHub repository that defines a GitHub Actions workflow.
provenance: GitHub Actions workflows and actions documentation; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: One execution of a GitHub Actions workflow.
An event or configured condition that causes a GitHub Actions workflow to run.
An individual task within a GitHub Actions job.
provenance: GitHub Actions workflows and actions documentation; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: A machine that executes jobs in a GitHub Actions workflow.
A GitHub-managed runner used to execute GitHub Actions jobs.
A runner managed by the repository owner or organization rather than by GitHub.
A GitHub grouping used to control access to self-hosted runners.
A set of parameter combinations used by a GitHub Actions strategy to create related job runs.
provenance: GitHub Actions matrix strategy documentation; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: A GitHub Actions strategy that expands one job definition across combinations of matrix values.
provenance: GitHub Actions matrix strategy documentation; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: A named GitHub Actions object that exposes information to workflow expressions.
GitHub Actions syntax that evaluates values, operators, functions, and context data.
provenance: GitHub Actions expressions and contexts reference; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: A declared value supplied to a reusable or manually dispatched GitHub Actions workflow.
provenance: GitHub Actions workflow input documentation; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: A declared value exposed by a reusable GitHub Actions workflow.
provenance: GitHub Actions reusable workflows documentation; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: A value exposed by a GitHub Actions job for use by dependent jobs or workflow outputs.
provenance: GitHub Actions workflow syntax documentation; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: A value exposed by a GitHub Actions step for use by later workflow logic.
A command used by a GitHub Actions step to communicate with the runner during a workflow.
provenance: GitHub Actions workflow commands documentation; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: A GitHub Actions grouping key used to limit concurrent workflow runs or jobs.
A GitHub environment used to govern deployment jobs, protection rules, and environment-scoped values.
provenance: GitHub Actions deployment environments documentation; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: The GitHub Actions manual-dispatch event used to start a workflow explicitly.
provenance: GitHub Actions events documentation for workflow_dispatch; reviewed 2026-08-17

terms.definition: The GitHub repository-dispatch event that can trigger workflows from external activity.
provenance: GitHub Actions events documentation for repository_dispatch; reviewed 2026-08-17
